title: Sequence Reconstruction
description: Check if the original sequence can be uniquely reconstructed from a set of sequences using Kahn's algorithm (topological sort).
pseudocode:
1. Build adjacency list and in-degree count
2. Add nodes with 0 in-degree to queue
3. While queue length is 1
4. Pop node, add to result, update neighbors
5. If neighbor's in-degree is 0, push to queue
6. Return result length == original length

steps.note: Queue initialized with nodes having 0 in-degree: [1]
Queue length is 1 (only node 1), proceeding to extract unique node
Pop 1, result is [1], decrement in-degree of node 2
Node 2 in-degree is 0, add 2 to queue. Queue is [2]
Loop finishes, result is [1, 2, 3]. Length matches, unique reconstruction confirmed.
